system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template creating a service account for a Cloud Function that needs to read from a specific Cloud Storage bucket.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template creating a service account for a Cloud Function that needs to read from a specific Cloud Storage bucket.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
  - path: templates/service_account.jinja
  - path: templates/iam_binding.jinja

resources:
  - name: cf-bucket-reader-sa
    type: iam.v1.serviceAccount
    properties:
      accountId: cf-bucket-reader
      displayName: Cloud Function Bucket Reader Service Account
      description: Service account used by Cloud Function to read objects from a specific GCS bucket

  - name: cf-bucket-reader-bucket-iam
    type: gcp-types/storage-v1:virtual.buckets.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      bucket: $(ref.target-bucket.name)
      role: roles/storage.objectViewer
      member: serviceAccount:$(ref.cf-bucket-reader-sa.email)
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - cf-bucket-reader-sa
        - target-bucket

  - name: cf-bucket-reader-legacy-bucket-reader
    type: gcp-types/storage-v1:virtual.buckets.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      bucket: $(ref.target-bucket.name)
      role: roles/storage.legacyBucketReader
      member: serviceAccount:$(ref.cf-bucket-reader-sa.email)
    metadata:
      dependsOn:
        - cf-bucket-reader-sa
        - target-bucket
        - cf-bucket-reader-bucket-iam

  - name: target-bucket
    type: storage.v1.bucket
    properties:
      name: my-cf-source-data-bucket-prod
      location: US
      storageClass: STANDARD
      iamConfiguration:
        uniformBucketLevelAccess:
          enabled: true
        publicAccessPrevention: enforced
      versioning:
        enabled: true
      encryption:
        defaultKmsKeyName: ""
      lifecycle:
        rule:
          - action:
              type: Delete
            condition:
              age: 365
              isLive: false
      labels:
        environment: production
        managed-by: deployment-manager

outputs:
  - name: serviceAccountEmail
    value: $(ref.cf-bucket-reader-sa.email)
  - name: serviceAccountName
    value: $(ref.cf-bucket-reader-sa.name)
  - name: bucketName
    value: $(ref.target-bucket.name)
